title: Pronunciation of Sans Souci Hall
summary: They settle how to spell and say Sans Souci Hall.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: I was wondering how that worked. I'd just like one more question. Something that struck my mind a little earlier, you were talking about the San Suu Ksi Hall.
Usually I've heard that pronounced San Suu. Is that the correct pronunciation? San Suu Ksi. San Suu Ksi.
You sing a sign, haven't you, Ralph? Yeah, but I've usually heard it pronounced San Suu. I thought it was French.
